title: 27N artists' ministry campaign from November2020
notes: Campaign and dialogue continued in December and January; the original physical assembly is not shown to have remained continuous. January 27 was a separate gathering below 50 (X001). November attendance and online signatures cannot count as January crowds.

title: Havana portworkers' December wage dispute
notes: A December 28 account describes refusal to load ships and an online complaint. First physical date unknown. January wage effects do not establish a new gathering or physical continuation.

title: SanctiSpíritus pork sellers' December stoppage
notes: A December 22 account says the 16-day stoppage ended with return on Saturday after a Friday agreement. Boundary context only; no January continuation verified.
